paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Answer.**
1000 Richmond Terrace, Staten Island is not mapped within any of the NYC DEP stormwater flood scenarios [dep_extreme_2080][dep_moderate_2050].

**Hazard Reader.**
This address sits outside the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint (NYC OEM) [sandy_inundation]. This address sits in FEMA flood zone X, per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970188F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
